# Ubuntu

A minimal Ubuntu 24.04 development container with a non-root vscode user.

## Use

Template reference: `ghcr.io/hoshiori-dev/devcontainer-templates/ubuntu:1.0.0`

Apply with the Dev Container CLI:

```sh
devcontainer templates apply --template-id ghcr.io/hoshiori-dev/devcontainer-templates/ubuntu:1.0.0
```

## Notes

This template uses the official Ubuntu 24.04 development container base image. It connects as the
non-root `vscode` user, which has passwordless sudo access. No additional language runtimes or Dev
Container Features are installed by this template.

The upstream image tag can receive updates. Rebuild the container to consume them. Both Linux amd64
and arm64 are tested by this repository.
